photos.title: File:Lower Manhattan skyline and Governors Island from Rockaway Ferry, New York Harbor - 20200904.jpg
photos.author: Andre Carrotflower
photos.description: View of the Lower Manhattan skyline (right background) and Governors Island (left and center, foreground) as seen from the Rockaway Ferry as it traverses New York Harbor's Buttermilk Channel, September 2020. Prominently visible on Governors Island is Building #12, constructed in 1931 as officers' quarters for the 16th Infantry Regiment, which was stationed at the adjacent Fort Jay from 1922 through 1941.
